name: Alaska
tagline: THE MASTER SIX · the man with the sax · steward of the Music Space
bio: Saxophonist and selector of the pop-up cities — sax AND decks in one musician. Steward of the Devcon 8 Music Space (DIP #8576) alongside Shaka, Aakash and Tomo; channel 21 of the Circle Patch is his saxophone, clip-miced so the horn can walk into the crowd. His July 2026 feedback — 'too Web3 for general humanity' — birthed the orchestra's 📖 Definition Button ('Words We Play By'): a contribution to the orchestra's soul, not just its sound. His rider workstream: decentralized streaming + on-chain artist donations. Mononym by design — in the pop-up cities one name is enough.
quote: …barefoot uke, butterflies on sax, Alaska at the decks, Morat on bass, and the whole garden dancing 🎶 — Cannes, ETHCC afterparty, Palais des Festivals
songs_note: No recordings hosted by design — the horn is Alaska's; he blesses what goes open, item by item.
honesty: MDRN/Subcult/Onda verified as one connected project family (mdrn.music links to both, Aug 2026); Alaska's authorship presented as the family remembers it, awaiting Alaska's own correction.
